Nivel de vechime: Începător
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Dezvoltare de software
JOB DESCRIPTION 
 We are looking for a good and passionate software developer working for Life Science Industry, using professional equipments and tools, architecting, designing, implementing and unit testing different system functionalities for a web platform fulfilling bio store needs. You will have the unique opportunity to contribute along other engineers and scientists to the development of solutions that revolutionize medical research & treatment techniques and instruments.
 The ideal candidate should be a smart, open minded person and open to travel, able to parse through functional requirements and technical design documents to come up with proper architecture and implementation to provide good software quality and support to our clients.
 EXPERIENCE 
 Experience in web software development with C# .NET and DataBase is mandatory
 Web development skills are mandatory (JavaScript frameworks)
 Database development skills are mandatory (SQL Server, PostGreSQL or other)
 OOP skills / SOLID principle with clean architecture are mandatory
 AI code assist is a plus (i.e. GitHUb Copilot)
 B.S. / M.S. in Engineering or Computer Science is preferred
 RESPONSIBILITIES 
 Reviewing and understanding the requirements
 Architecting, designing, coding and unit testing product functionalities
 Integrating software modules and third party apps
 Be a strong full-time contributor to the project, with minimum technical supervision
 Communicate with UK based customers
 Location: Timisoara 
 Take advantage of this opportunity to move your career forward!
